# Uddannelsesindsigt — udvidet kontekst til søge- og AI-agenter

Canonical URL: https://uddannelsesindsigt.com/
Language: Danish
Audience: Young people comparing Danish higher-education programmes
Programme count: 1,413
Admissions source: UFM/KOT
AI model version: 2026.6
AI model updated: 2026-09-10

## What the service does

Uddannelsesindsigt is independent decision support. It lets users search and
compare all Danish higher-education programmes by admission threshold, place
and educational content. AI robustness is an explicit opt-in perspective and
is disabled by default. The service does not make admission or career guarantees
and does not replace official guidance.

## O*NET 31.0 model coverage

- 569/1,413 programmes (40.27%) have a non-default legacy DISCO mapping and use
  O*NET 31.0-derived model inputs.
- 844/1,413 programmes (59.73%) lack that mapping, are excluded from AI ranking
  and are shown without a programme-specific AI estimate.
- The O*NET-SOC to ESCO/ISCO mapping uses the published O*NET-ESCO crosswalk.
- The programme-to-DISCO mapping is still a low-confidence model step, even for
  migrated programmes. It is not an official Danish education-to-job mapping.

## AI score formula

ai_resilience = clamp(0.75 * (1 - automation_risk) +
                      0.25 * augmentation_potential,
                      0.10, 1.00)

O*NET Work Activities importance ratings are normalized from 1–5 to 0–1. The
model's activity groups and coefficients are documented at:
https://uddannelsesindsigt.com/evidens

O*NET publishes occupational activity ratings. It does not publish the site's
automation_risk, augmentation_potential or ai_resilience values. Those are
Uddannelsesindsigt model estimates.

## Epistemic labels

- OBSERVED: directly measured in a named source.
- DERIVED: deterministic calculation from observed data.
- CROSSWALK: transferred between documented classifications.
- MODEL: explicit model assumption or estimate.
- PROVENANCE_REQUIRED: a value exists, but programme-level source linkage is incomplete.
- UNKNOWN: status cannot currently be established.

Never convert MODEL, CROSSWALK or PROVENANCE_REQUIRED values into observed
Danish outcomes. Never describe the AI score as probability of unemployment or
job replacement.

## Citation guidance

When citing an admission threshold, identify the year and UFM/KOT as source.
When citing an AI score, include "modelestimat", model version 2026.6 and the
programme's O*NET coverage status. Do not infer an AI score for an uncovered
programme, and do not present small score differences as precise forecasts.
